subtitle: Lesson 22 · Gating on model quality, not just code

eyebrow: A third stage, not just two

steps.label: CT
steps.sub: retrain and re-validate on fresh data

code:
jobs:
  test-and-train:
    steps:
      - run: pytest tests/
      - run: python train.py --output model.pkl
      - run: python validate.py \
          --model model.pkl --min-auc 0.85
  deploy-staging:
    needs: test-and-train
  deploy-production:
    needs: deploy-staging
    environment: production
caption: Three gates: code tests, model validation, then a human-reviewed production environment.

code:
def validate(model, X_test, y_test,
             baseline_auc, min_auc=0.85):
    preds = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
    auc = roc_auc_score(y_test, preds)
    assert auc >= min_auc
    assert auc >= baseline_auc - 0.01
    return auc
caption: Checks an absolute threshold AND a regression against the current production model.
